results.title: Pollywogs
results.overview: Pilar and Isabel. Mario and Jaime. Two mothers. Two children. A new family unit. A new normal. Well, at least that is what Pilar and Isabel hope will happen during their week-long vacation in a rural house: that their respective 13-year-old children will be able to understand their relationship, their love, and that they will be able to connect and accept each other as what they should be: siblings. But, of course, there are many ways to connect and accept each other.

results.title: Who Wants to Marry an Astronaut?
results.overview: David is a dopey hopeless romantic with a hippy mother and a best friend who also works for him. After fifteen years of living together, on an impulse, he decides to ask his partner to marry him in Las Vegas. His anticipation for the dream wedding and trip is crushed when his partner answers ‘No’. David decides to power through with his plans and now he has ten days to find the knight in shining armor that will marry him in Las Vegas.

results.title: Memoirs of Teatro da Cornucópia
results.overview: A renowned symbol of Portuguese interventionist theatre, Cornucópia emerged from the darkness of fascism to fight dictatorship on stage. Among the classics, a project is born and dies, but one face remains emblematic: Luís Miguel Cintra, who shared his art with the constant complicity of set designer Cristina Reis. Together, guided by images, they bear witness, telling this story.

results.title: Paraxnormal
results.overview: 4 desperate friends trying to change their lives by robbing a mysterious old bungalow they believe hides gold and treasures.

results.title: Realm of Satan
results.overview: An experiential portrait depicting Satanists in both the everyday and in the extraordinary as they fight to preserve their lifestyle: magic, mystery, and misanthropy.

results.title: Grow
results.overview: In the self-proclaimed ‘Pumpkin Capital of the World’, no-nonsense curmudgeonly farmer Dinah Little takes in her estranged niece Charlie, who decides to enter the local pumpkin growing competition where she and the other growers face fierce competition, sabotage, and a genetically engineered rival.

results.title: The Boxer
results.overview: A man emerges from a box and approaches his van.

results.title: Choque de Cultura: Transporte das Estrelas
results.original_title: Choque de Cultura: Transporte das Estrelas
results.overview: Julinho asks Renan for help after stealing Rogerinho’s van, and they organize a raffle. Simone enters the scene to recover the cargo. Maurílio needs to pick up Cauã Reymond but faces difficulties.

results.title: Malka
results.overview: Malka, a Holocaust survivor, begins seeing visions of her past during a family seder and must find hope in the present to survive, just as she did in the past.

results.title: Deadly
results.overview: In 1900's rural Australia a First Nations man, ‘Deadly’, raised by a colonising Police Captain and exploited by the government as a tracker, discovers the secrets of his past and seeks redemption by helping an innocent Elder escape execution.

results.title: El céntimo
results.overview: A waiter and his customer argue over change in a situation that could change their lives forever.

results.title: Trainwreck: Poop Cruise
results.overview: An engine fire leaves 4,000 passengers stranded at sea without power and plumbing in this wild documentary about the infamous "poop cruise" of 2013.

results.title: Mariana's Room
results.overview: In the darkest days of the Second World War, Yulia and Hugo, a Jewish mother and son, escape from a Ukrainian ghetto. Fearing for his safety, Yulia entrusts her boy to the care of her friend Mariana, a sex worker who lives in a brothel. Hugo is placed in a closet, nominally for his safety, but from which he rarely leaves. With little view of the outside world, he conjures up ghosts and scenarios. But over time, Mariana brings the boy out and in doing so transforms his life.

results.title: Exorcism at School
results.overview: After two reckless teenagers explore a mysterius cabin close to their school, one of them gets posessed by an unseen force. And now, a group of friends have to reverse the posession before it's too late.

results.title: Holybelly
results.overview: The day after an umpteenth overwhelming romantic encounter, Carla finds herself at home with the only person aware of her difference, Noémie, her best friend. It was the encounter too many. She decides to leave a message to all those people so close yet so far from her.

results.title: Yolki 12
results.overview: On New Year's Eve, nine-year-old Vanya from Kirov, having learned of his parents' separation, sets off for Veliky Ustyug to ask Father Frost for a miracle.

results.title: Rise and Fight: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill
results.original_title: Rise and Fight: The Battle of Hobkirk's Hill
results.overview: Patriot Southern Command under General Nathaniel Greene organizes militias for a push against the British.

results.title: A Pickleball Christmas
results.overview: Fresh off the biggest win of his career, tennis star Luke Hollis heads home to Florida for Christmas, only to discover his family’s racquet club is on the verge of being sold. Teaming up with Caroline, the club’s pickleball coach, Luke reluctantly agrees to compete in a high-stakes holiday tournament that could save the club. As sparks fly both on and off the court, Luke realizes the greatest victory might just be love, family, and a new chapter at home.

results.title: The Little Girl Who Lived
results.overview: When rising crime novelist Alice reveals her childhood abduction in a new book, the killer returns-kidnapping her sister and demanding she rewrite his legacy before cancer takes him for good.
